verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agents run in a checkout on the user's own machine and poll for human-approved tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented way to trigger an agent from a CI/CD pipeline to fix a broken build or failing test. The CLI can be run from scripts or cron, and the GitHub product-review checks can be re-run with '@foreloop retest', but these are building blocks and adjacent features. Neither is a CI-triggered fix agent, and every run still waits on human approval.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test
